flagged_claims.claim_text: per the FY2018 10-K, Consolidated Balance Sheets

flagged_claims.claim_text: FY2020 Net Accounts Receivable (AR) for FY2020 is $947 million
flagged_claims.reason: Amcor completed the acquisition of Bemis in June 2019. FY2020 represents the first full year of the combined entity, which significantly increased revenue scale. A decrease in AR from $1,235 million (FY2018) to $947 million (FY2020) contradicts the expected consolidation impact of a major acquisition unless accompanied by massive divestitures or policy changes not mentioned.
Specific page numbers cited for SEC filings are a common hallucination pattern in LLMs. Given the filing type (10-K) is already incorrect, the specific page number is almost certainly fabricated.
